metricDefinitions.meanInteractivity: Output tokens/s/user; reciprocal of mean TPOT, unchanged from original result.
metricDefinitions.totalThroughput: Logical input plus output tokens/s across all allocated GPUs, unchanged from original result; cached input included for prepared-prefix workloads.
metricDefinitions.throughput: Original total input plus output throughput per physical GPU; shared prefill/decode GPU counts are not added.
metricDefinitions.ttft: Mean TTFT in seconds; no percentile value inferred.
metricDefinitions.endToEnd: Mean request end-to-end latency in seconds; no percentile value inferred.
